## Requirements (contract)

1. **Role taxonomy** — publisher/operator/owner/vendor/prime contractor/buyer-access roles under
   one canonical mapping; consistent in connector output and accountability joins; a publisher
   label (OSM-contributor case) never evidences an operator; an authoritative operator field still
   mints `camera_operator`.
2. **Source genre/directness** — `template`/`subscription`/`recommendation` genres are
   non-probative (D6) for every predicate.
3. **Count scope** — comparability scope-qualified; `299 metro ≠ ~90+100 city` is a scope
   mismatch (`SCOPE_MIXED`), not a contradiction; same-scope disagreement stays a contradiction;
   scope carried through claim qualifiers → materialization → API reads → dossier.
4. **Derived sums** — explicitly derived approximate roll-ups (~190): L4, labelled, naming
   inputs/bases/scope/assumptions, never an observation; undeclared/mixed/indistinguishable
   sub-populations refuse.
5. **Seed data** — honest scopes + `evidence_origin=seed_fixture` on `ops/seed.py` claims;
   qualifier vocabulary registered before write; ODbL compartment untouched.
6. **Organization identity** — jurisdiction/source-scoped name-only keys (`sig.org.name_scoped`),
   `candidate=True` + identity basis recorded; never auto-union identical names across
   jurisdictions; strong same-scope external ids join; ambiguity/disposition hooks +
   `partner-name-audit` dry-run report; legacy keys preserved for audit; P31.13 generic-FEMA
   refusal preserved.
7. **Public/read surfaces** — count scope + evidence origin on API models/routes/store; scope
   labels in dossier output; scope-partitioned resolutions render without a phantom winner.
